name: Spare the Dying
description:
You touch a creature that has 0 Endurance and is not dead. If the creature is dying, it is no longer dying. After an hour, if the creature has not taken any additional damage, it wakes up with 1 Endurance.

Describe how you bring them back from the brink.

improvements.name: Revivify
improvements.description: You may instead touch a creature that has died within the last minute. That creature returns to life with 0 Endurance and remains unconscious. If the creature died due to old age, the spell has no effect. If the creature is missing a limb or other body part, the spell does not restore it.
